recentItems.title: Nnoruka, Remogat hold the fort as UP overwhelms UST | ABS-CBN SPORTS | ABS-CBN Sports
recentItems.description:
University of the Philippines found its footing in the fourth period to overwhelm University of Santo Tomas, 92-85, for a victorious start to the UAAP Season 89 men's basketball tournament on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.

Francis Nnoruka had his way inside with 18 points, 12 rebounds, a block, and a thunderous one-handed jam to end the game, while Noy Remogat tallied 11 points, including timely three-pointers in the last canto.

recentItems.title: Montebon, Edding step up as Adamson completes comeback win vs. FEU | ABS-CBN Sports
recentItems.description:
Matthew Montebon and Mat Edding stepped up as Adamson University crawled back from a 13-point deficit against Far Eastern University for a 56-53 win to open UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.

Montebon fired 18 points on four triples, while Edding stabilized the floor with 10 points, three assists, two rebounds, and two blocks as the Soaring Falcons' defense held on to force Kirby Mongcopa to miss his game-tying attempt in the endgame.

recentItems.title: Tovera a revelation as La Salle escapes NU to start title defense | ABS-CBN Sports
recentItems.description:
Joaquin Tovera was a revelation as De La Salle University opened its UAAP Season 89 title defense on a winning note.

The Green Archers rookie fired 22 points on 8-of-11 shooting as La Salle escaped National University, 89-87, for a winning debut on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.
